notes.title: Major update!
notes.content:
Critical bugs were fixed in the game, because of which some players (the bug did not appear with you) could not escape from the monster, as the energy of running was quickly spent. Now the player's energy is spent 60 percent slower! The lighting in the basement was also improved (a level with escape from a monster) so that the player could pass the level easier.
Minor bugs have also been fixed. Improved game optimization.
The game has implemented automatic saving of the last level at which the player stopped playing. Now you can download the game from the main menu.
One new achievement "New Game" has been added. It turns out easily and quickly.
